_replace: TeamTrack's feature list as the harness writes it for F1. One entry per feature; every entry starts with passes false, evidence null, and testedAt null. The schema rejects every _replace key on purpose, so an unfilled list fails validation: delete each one when the file is filled.

features._replace: id: a short, stable id. category: a label (TeamTrack uses feature). description: one sentence a user would recognise. steps: observable checks a reviewer can run. Set passes to true only with evidence (gate_id, commit, visible and existing test counts such as 41/41, the house rules that passed) and the testedAt time.
features.description: Org-wide issue search with filters and cursor pagination
steps: GET /issues lists the caller's org's issues across its projects.
Filters are optional and combine with AND.
Deleted issues and issues of archived projects are never listed.
A project_id or assignee_id that is not in the caller's org gives 404 not_found.
Any role may read (admin, member, viewer). Without a token: 401.
